note: Claims are each fund's own stated objectives, paraphrased from its annual report. Labels are a preliminary reading of the data, set by a person, not by code.

claims.claim: Aims to deliver medium- to long-term capital appreciation.
claims.metric: Total return based on NAV, six months to June 30, 2026 (BXPE U.S., Class I Series I)
claims.context: A single six-month period, in a strategy described as medium- to long-term. One period says little about the long run.

claims.claim: To a lesser extent, aims to generate modest current income.
claims.metric: Net investment income per unit, six months to June 30, 2026
claims.value: −$0.01 (a small net investment loss); no distributions shown for the period
claims.context: Over this period, returns came from changes in value rather than income, which fits a fund where income is a secondary goal.

claims.claim: Structured with monthly, fully funded subscriptions and periodic redemptions.
claims.value: Expects to redeem up to 3% of units a quarter across the fund; 5% deduction on units held under two years; can be changed or suspended
claims.context: Redemptions are periodic and limited, as described. The limit applies across the whole fund, so heavy requests would be prorated (see Liquidity Simulator).
